reuse.why: Calls the existing shared pieces (assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, BankSyncError, getServer) but the tree has no shared link/download routine and none is extracted, so the flow itself is not reused.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount/linkSimpleFinAccount (~80 lines) and downloadFintegraTransactions a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (~40 lines), differing only in the provider string and server URL.

placement.why: Each piece lands where its siblings live: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts, account type in types/models, provider id in SYNC_PROVIDERS.

scope.why: Focused on the provider; the two desktop-client edits are the minimal ones forced by the exhaustive Record<BankSyncProviders, ...> types even though the request said client UI is separate.

maintainability.why: Follows the established per-provider pattern so it is easy to read, but adds a sixth copy of the link flow and a third copy of the token/post/error download, so fixes to that flow must be repeated again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse; no shared abstraction is skipped.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of linkAkahuAccount and downloadAkahuTransactions are verbatim, not reshaped.
